about_short_description.short_description: United Real Estate is a real estate development and investment company.

product.name: Real Estate Development
product.description: Development of residential, commercial, retail, office, hospitality, and mixed-use properties across Kuwait and the MENA region.

identifier.value: Real Estate Operations, Property Management and Leasing

product.name: Real Estate Operations, Property Management and Leasing
product.description: Operation, leasing, and management of commercial, residential, retail, and mixed-use properties, including offices, shops, apartments, and community facilities.

product.name: Hospitality and Hotel Operations
product.description: Development and operation of hotels, resorts, serviced residences, and related hospitality assets in the MENA region.

product.name: Construction and Contracting Services
product.description: Construction and contracting services for real estate, infrastructure, residential, commercial, and mixed-use development projects.

product.name: Project Management
product.description: Planning, coordinating, and overseeing real estate development and construction projects from design and execution through completion.

product.name: Facilities Management
product.description: Management and maintenance of building systems, shared areas, and operational facilities for commercial, residential, retail, and hospitality properties.
